conditions.description: release_ref is interpolated into a command string and executed with eval, so shell metacharacters in the argument can execute additional commands.
conditions.rationale: eval reparses argument-derived text as shell syntax instead of passing the release ref as one Git argument.

conditions.description: artifact_spec is interpolated into an upload command and executed with eval, creating a second argument-controlled shell execution boundary.
conditions.rationale: The caller-controlled artifact specification is reparsed as shell code by eval.

conditions.description: The cleanup trap quotes workdir and uses rm -rf --, which is a negative control against claiming the temporary directory deletion is unquoted option/path injection.
conditions.rationale: The supplied cleanup path uses both quoting and an option terminator.

conditions.description: Whether the workflow caller constrains release_ref and artifact_spec to trusted fixed values cannot be established from this script alone.
conditions.rationale: Workflow dispatch/event configuration is outside the supplied fixture.

conditions.description: Release-script safety must not be cleared while eval executes argument-derived strings or the caller trust boundary remains unverified.
conditions.rationale: set -euo pipefail does not remove command-injection semantics from eval.
